name: @opafex/retrieval-core
description: Storage-agnostic retrieval for RAG: chunking, IDF-weighted rare-term matching and a vector + lexical merge, over three small ports. Zero dependencies.

scripts.check:dist: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m=>{if(typeof m.retrieve!=='function')throw new Error('retrieve missing');console.log('dist loads in plain Node')})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:dist
